- [USER] User asked about significant political movements or parties that have emerged in Panama since independence and their impact on the country's development.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Panama gained independence from Spain in 1821.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The National Liberal Party (PLN) was founded in 1903 and played a crucial role in Panama's separation from Colombia.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Democratic Revolutionary Party (PRD) was founded in 1979 and advocated for social justice and economic equality.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Omar Torrijos was a prominent leader of the PRD and held autocratic rule until his death in 1981.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The PRD won every presidential election from 1984 to 2004.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Panamenista Party was founded in 1984 and is a conservative party associated with Arnulfo Arias.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Democratic Change Party (CD) was founded in 1998 and promotes free-market policies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The PLN's policies favored the wealthy, while the PRD introduced reforms that helped reduce poverty and inequality.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Panamenista Party and CD have played important roles in shaping Panama's economic development but have faced controversies.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The PRD passed labor laws to protect workers' rights, including maternity leave and minimum wage laws.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] These reforms improved living conditions for many Panamanians and contributed to reducing poverty and increasing access to education and health care.
